key_terms: The sharing server's API that authorizes a recipient and returns table metadata and eligible files.
A temporary object-store URL the server returns for one data file, letting the client read bytes directly without the bearer token.
The path by which the client downloads Parquet bytes from object storage, separate from the control requests.
The protocol field stating the lowest reader version a response requires. The course client accepts only version 1 and refuses anything else.
The explicit set of data hosts the client may fetch from, which keeps it from following arbitrary URLs or redirects.
evidence: Actual portable basic-Parquet protocol client plus separately prepared native Scala reference-server/table-store route. No local server, advanced Delta/CDF or unsupported ARM feature acceptance is inferred.
